caseName: Adams v. Secretary of the Navy
caseNameFull: Adams v. Secretary of the Navy

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 414 U. S. 1128.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that William A. Dougheity, Esquire, of Tustin, California, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioners in this case.
